guide.title: Exact finite-feature kernels
guide.summary: polynomial, monomial and delta kernels reduced exactly to TENSOR-001 feature states: kernel sums over selected pairs (weights, self-pair exclusion, ordered or unordered), kernel mean embeddings, biased and unbiased MMD and witness values as exact rationals; kernels without an exact finite feature map, or one the state does not retain, refused, never approximated.

KERNEL-001.cpu: Native C (math_kernel.c): kernels with an explicit finite feature map, polynomial (x.y + c)^d (d <= 8, |c|^d <= 2^127 - 1; linear and homogeneous included), declared monomial sums sum_t w_t x^a_t y^a_t and delta kernels (categorical match, NULL a category of its own), reduced to TENSOR-001 states: the listwise moment tensor of order D >= d over (1, x_1..x_n), or the count tensor, with per group W = sum w, Q = sum w^2 and the declared kernel's self-pair sum sum w^2 k(x, x) (1024 bits, proven to fit before any row is read); exact kernel sums over selected pairs (across groups, within a group with or without self-pairs, ordered or unordered) and their weighted pair counts, kernel mean inner products, biased and unbiased MMD^2 and witness values, as exact rationals in 1024-bit words (overflow refused per request, never wrapped), evaluated over the C(n + d, d) sorted multi-indices with their multiplicities; any kernel the state retains (family, degree <= D, a subset of its columns) is evaluated on the same state, an absent degree, dimension or family is refused (UNSUPPORTED), and RBF, Laplace and other kernels are refused, never approximated; budgets (the tensor's needs, 288 bytes a group, evaluation items, output) checked before allocation.
KERNEL-001.gpu: CUDA kernels math_kernel_gpu.cu: the feature state (tr_mgpu_kernel_build: TENSOR-001's device build of the feature tensor, then one work item per row slice summing W, Q and Dg locally and adding them with exact atomics, the 1024-bit sums by a local 16-word atomic carry chain), adopted by tr_kernel_from_states after consistency checks; batched requests (tr_mgpu_kernel_upload once per state and kernel, then tr_mgpu_kernel_query: one work item per request running the shared evaluator tr_kernel_eval_request, one output slot each); equal to the CPU bit for bit.
limitations: Exact finite-feature kernels only: RBF, Laplace and other kernels without an exact finite feature map are refused (declared approximations are KERNEL-002's).

The feature tensor stores (n + 1)^D cells per group (dense, or sparse at the data's support), so the tensor budget bounds the dimension and degree; listwise only (a row with a NULL feature column does not contribute).
Answers are limited to 1024 bits (refused beyond) and are unreduced num / den natively; the CUDA query kernel has a 1984-byte stack frame with register spills and runs one work item per request.
